zh-CN.title: 更顺手的说明与进度编辑
items: Markdown 预览固定可见，手机从课题详情直接进入全屏说明编辑
任务进度改为评论式输入入口，修复评论等级标志与昵称错位

en.title: Smoother descriptions and progress updates
items: Markdown preview stays visible; project details open directly into full-screen editing on phones
Progress updates use a compact comment-style entry; comment level badges stay beside names
